post_message: In this Spotlight edition of the Sabin Vaccine Wire, we reflect on Sabin’s 2025 outbreak response and the evolving global immunization landscape.     When Ethiopia faced its first-ever Marburg outbreak, the country requested swift assistance — and we were able to leverage prior experience and existing partnerships to deliver our vaccine candidate as quickly as possible. We also spent the year thoughtfully recalibrating our global immunization strategy, staying focused on evidence, equity, and country leadership amid public health disruption.     Read reflections from CEO Amy Finan, President of R&D Kelly Lyn Warfield, and President of Global Immunization Rebecca Martin.
